message.content: Based on the conversation, Jareth expresses a preference for co-op gameplay, particularly in situations where he can share the experience with friends. This aligns with his statement that "it's always nice to share the experience with friends, especially in big battle scenes or challenging missions." Jareth enjoys co-op modes because they make tough parts of the game feel easier when there's a team to back him up. He seems to be particularly interested in cooperative missions that allow players to team up and take on challenges together. This indicates that Jareth appreciates the social aspect of multiplayer games, especially those designed for co-operative play.
